TZA.note: Document states no rule or authority on AI harms.
No government body is stated to use AI.
A university workshop on tutoring systems is not an AI tool in a public sector system.

facts.fact: Ghent University's IDLab-AIRO says it installed a new GPU workstation at Mzumbe University in Morogoro, from which a workshop served LLMs, image generation and speech pipelines, as the university's new Centre for AI Research and Innovation (CAIRI) was inaugurated.
